rows.rationale: Use the attested ICT Undo command, not a generic Cancel button label. It names reversal, without promising every pending shape can later be restored.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: ClassicPaintActivity.undoEdit first calls cancelPending; when no pending edit was discarded it calls document.undo. Pending polygon/curve/changed trim can therefore be discarded without moving the history stack. PaintDocument.moveHistory restores prior pixels/credits and clears selection.
rows.independent_check_question: Check the standalone imperative’s familiarity and distinction from Cancel and Redo; do not imply discarded unfinished geometry is redoable.

rows.rationale: The explicit again-do command distinguishes Redo from Undo. Here it reinstates committed undo history, rather than replaying arbitrary gestures or repeating the current command.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: redoEdit discards pending geometry then calls document.redo, moving the redo history entry back to undo. The button requires document.canRedo; no promise that an unfinished gesture discarded by Undo is recoverable.
rows.independent_check_question: Confirm idiomatic command form and clear pairwise contrast with Undo.

rows.rationale: Use the ICT clipboard command, not a crop or scissors-only instruction. The button’s selection/clipboard context disambiguates the ordinary cut verb.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: cutSelection first copies the transformed selected image to the app clipboard, then deletes the selection. Nonfloating selected pixels are replaced by background colour; a floating selection is discarded. It does not crop canvas dimensions.
rows.independent_check_question: Check conventional clipboard-cut idiom; do not add a crop, transparency or file-deletion promise.

rows.rationale: Use the glossary’s verb ቅዳ, not its distinct noun ቅጂ. This requests a duplicate of the selected image content; it does not imply clipboard sharing outside this app.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: copySelection renders the transformed selection, replaces the app clipboard bitmap and its credits, and leaves the visible selected content in place. No selection produces a separate explanatory message.
rows.independent_check_question: Confirm clipboard-copy imperative and avoid noun substitution.

rows.rationale: The attested ICT command matches inserting previously copied image content, not physical glue or automatic placement at a text caret.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: pasteSelection chooses SELECT (committing previous pending work), then document.paste uses the private image clipboard by default. It creates a floating selection at origin after validation/checkpoint; placement and later compositing remain separate. Missing clipboard content shows a hint.
rows.independent_check_question: Confirm software-paste idiom; no system clipboard, caret or immediate flattening guarantee.

rows.rationale: The attested Select All command expresses the entire available canvas area in this editor, not every file, tool or menu option.

confidence.type: author AI assessment, not native certification

rows.consumer_context: Edit menu and Ctrl+A call selectAll: choose SELECT, then select bounds0,0,width,height of the current bitmap. Prior floating/pending work is committed through selection/tool transition. The operation does not select all documents.
rows.independent_check_question: Check natural complete imperative for all canvas pixels; neither plural handling nor formatting is introduced. Compare address/register with historical plural/polite ምረጡ; draft uses glossary form, not an established app-wide style rule.
